text: {"rules":[{"id":"RHD-SCREEN-PREG-FIRST-VISIT","version":"2004","title":"Rh(D) blood typing and antibody testing at first pregnancy-related care visit","source_quote":"The USPSTF strongly recommends Rh(D) blood typing and antibody testing for all pregnant women during their first visit for pregnancy-related care.","grade":"A","effective_date":"2004-02","action":"Perform Rh(D) blood typing and antibody testing for all pregnant women during their first visit for pregnancy-related care.","denominator":"{\"all\":[{\"sex\":{\"is\":\"F\"},\"quote\":\"pregnant women\"},{\"condition\":{\"concept\":\"pregnancy\",\"onset_by\":\"{MY}-12-31\"},\"quote\":\"all pregnant women\",\"derived\":{\"onset_by\":\"text gives no measurement period; assumes pregnancy recorded by end of measurement year\"}}]}","numerator":"{\"all\":[{\"observation\":{\"concept\":\"rh_d_blood_typing\",\"window\":[\"{MY}-01-01\",\"{MY}-12-31\"],\"pick\":\"any\"},\"quote\":\"Rh(D) blood typing\",\"derived\":{\"window\":\"text ties timing to the first pregnancy-related visit, not a calendar window; measurement year used as a placeholder pending review\"}},{\"observation\":{\"concept\":\"rh_antibody_screen\",\"window\":[\"{MY}-01-01\",\"{MY}-12-31\"],\"pick\":\"any\"},\"quote\":\"antibody testing\",\"derived\":{\"window\":\"text ties timing to the first pregnancy-related visit, not a calendar window; measurement year used as a placeholder pending review\"}},{\"uncomputable\":{\"needs\":\"identification of the first pregnancy-related care visit and confirmation that testing occurred at that visit\"},\"quote\":\"during their first visit for pregnancy-related care\"}]}","exclusions":"[]"}],"coverage_notes":["New concepts not in vocabulary: rh_d_blood_typing (Rh(D) blood type determination) and rh_antibody_screen (red cell antibody screen); these need value sets.","Timing requirement 'during their first visit for pregnancy-related care' is event-relative, not measurement-year-relative; encoded as uncomputable. The measurement-year windows on the lab observations are placeholders declared as derived and require human review.","Pregnancy episode boundaries (start date, multiple pregnancies within or across measurement years) are not representable; the denominator assumes a pregnancy recorded by the end of the measurement year (declared derived).","DATE field 'February 2004 *' carries an asterisk whose footnote meaning is not given in this section and is not represented.","No follow-up actions (e.g., repeat antibody testing later in pregnancy, Rh immune globulin) are stated in this section; none encoded."]}
